source_review.title: NAD+ metabolism in aging: a systematic review of NAD+ precursors

conclusion_summary: NAD+ precursors show moderate efficacy in raising NAD+ levels in humans; evidence for healthspan benefits remains preliminary.
limitations: Small sample sizes in most human trials
Lack of standardized outcome measures across studies

quantitative_claims.claim: 40-100% increase in NAD+ levels after NMN supplementation
10-30% improvement in insulin sensitivity with NAD+ precursor use
